description: This file contains a benchmark class for testing Orleans' map-reduce capabilities using BenchmarkDotNet. It includes setup, teardown, and core benchmarking methods that create and link grains to perform complex data processing pipelines.

classes.name: MapReduceBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class using BenchmarkDotNet to evaluate Orleans map-reduce pipeline performance with complex processing stages.

methods.name: BenchmarkSetup
methods.description: Initializes the Orleans test cluster before benchmarking.

methods.name: Bench
methods.description: Executes the asynchronous map-reduce pipeline in parallel for benchmarking.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all Orleans silos and cleans up resources after benchmarking.

methods.name: BenchCore
methods.description: Performs setup and execution of a complex map-reduce pipeline with multiple grains.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the Orleans test cluster.
